fusions.name: Snatch and Dart
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You slip away 20% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Churning School
fusions.desc: Looses 4 darts of water in a spread, each dealing 5 damage, and heals you for 15% of the damage they deal over 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 32%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Through the Fingers
fusions.desc: You slip 2 tiles from where you stood, and your armour rises by 15% and your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Grasp
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
